title: No Heroine. A Bald Akshay. Priyamani as the Villain. Golmaal FIVE Is Breaking Every Rule the Franchise Ever Had.
excerpt: Rohit Shetty's fifth instalment drops the love interest entirely, brings back Sharman Joshi after twenty years, and turns The Family Man's star into the comedy's central antagonist — all for the franchise's 20th anniversary in early 2027.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Golmaal FIVE features no heroine, focusing solely on ensemble comedy.
  • Priyamani is cast as the film's central villain, a first for the franchise.
  • Sharman Joshi returns after 20 years, rejoining the original cast.
  • The franchise has grossed over ₹600 crore from four films.
  • Golmaal FIVE targets a 2027 release for its 20th anniversary.
Twenty years ago, five idiots walked into a movie called *Golmaal: Fun Unlimited* and made ₹47 crore. Nobody knew they were watching the birth of Bollywood's most durable comedy franchise. https://youtube.com/watch?v=uwEKJBYpZj0 Now those idiots are back — and they've brought reinforcements. **Golmaal FIVE**, currently filming under **Rohit Shetty**'s direction, is shaping up to be the most audacious entry in the franchise's history. The returning ensemble — **Ajay Devgn**, **Arshad Warsi**, **Shreyas Talpade**, **Kunal Kemmu**, and **Tusshar Kapoor** — has been joined by two names that change the equation entirely. First: **Akshay Kumar**, who showed up in the announcement video on Rohit's birthday in March, bald-headed, gold-chained, wearing black aviators and the unmistakable energy of a man who has decided to have fun. Ajay Devgn's reaction to the casting was peak Devgn: *"Koi bhi franchise nhi chordta."* (Nobody leaves this franchise.) Second: **Sharman Joshi**, returning to the *Golmaal* universe for the first time since the original 2006 film. He was absent from *Golmaal Returns*, *Golmaal 3*, and *Golmaal Again*. Twenty years later, the prodigal member of the gang is home. https://www.instagram.com/reel/DV3Syj0gR0k/ And then there's the curveball nobody expected. > **"According to a *Variety India* exclusive reported by Bollywood Hungama, **Priyamani**'s casting is being treated as a "surprise card" by the production."** ## Priyamani — as the Villain The National Award-winning actress, best known to streaming audiences as Suchi from *The Family Man*, has been cast as the film's antagonist. Not a supporting player. Not a cameo. The actual villain, going head-to-head with the entire *Golmaal* gang. According to a *Variety India* exclusive reported by Bollywood Hungama, **Priyamani**'s casting is being treated as a "surprise card" by the production. She's previously worked with both Rohit Shetty — a dance number in *Chennai Express* — and Ajay Devgn in *Maidaan*, but this is the first time she's been positioned as the central antagonist of a major comedy franchise. How Shetty shapes a female villain inside the *Golmaal* universe — where the comedy runs on slapstick chaos and ensemble energy — will be one of the most interesting creative choices of the year. ![Fun Unlimited — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/b/b4/Golmaal-Fun_Unlimited.jpg) ## The No-Romance Gambit Here's the other major shift: *Golmaal FIVE* reportedly has **no heroine and no romantic subplot**. None. For Ajay Devgn, for Akshay Kumar, for anyone. The entire narrative focus is on the ensemble's group dynamics and the chaotic energy between the characters. This is a genuine departure. Every previous *Golmaal* film gave Devgn's character a love interest — Rimi Sen, Kareena Kapoor, Parineeti Chopra. Stripping that out signals that Shetty is betting on pure, uncut comic mayhem. The only woman in the room is the villain. That's a bold play.

## Franchise Veterans Return The supporting cast reads like a reunion tour. **Johny Lever**, **Sanjay Mishra**, **Mukesh Tiwari**, and **Ashwini Kalsekar** are all confirmed to return. For fans who grew up on the franchise's running gags, inside jokes, and escalating chaos, that roster alone is a promise. ## The Box Office Stakes The *Golmaal* franchise has grossed over ₹600 crore from four films, with each instalment outperforming the last: - *Golmaal* (2006): ₹47 crore — Superhit - *Golmaal Returns* (2008): ₹82 crore - *Golmaal 3* (2010): ₹162 crore — Blockbuster - *Golmaal Again* (2017): ₹309 crore The growth curve is relentless. If *Golmaal FIVE* continues the pattern, the ₹400-500 crore worldwide range isn't fantasy — it's the floor. ## A 20th Anniversary Homecoming
Key Cast Changes in Golmaal FIVE
›Akshay Kumar joins the cast as a new character.
›Sharman Joshi returns after 20 years.
›Priyamani is the first female villain in the franchise.
›No romantic subplot for any character.
**Targeting early 2027**, the release is timed intentionally for the franchise's 20th anniversary. For diaspora audiences across the US, UK, and Canada who grew up streaming these films at family gatherings, watch parties, and Diwali celebrations, this one's practically a homecoming. Rohit Shetty said he's been honest in his work for twenty years. With *Golmaal FIVE*, he's also being honest about what the audience actually wants: the boys, the chaos, no distractions, and Priyamani ready to ruin all of it.
